items.detail: Since 0.4.0: one contract per model kind, each with a scripted mock; a backend claims capabilities such as output streaming, and the backend-neutral checks hold every configuration to exactly what it was observed to do.

items.detail: Since 0.4.0: propose, authorize, reject, start, complete and fail, each from its source states only; the executor contract and the provisional-input barrier.

items.detail: Since 0.5.0: one multiport node for a model that listens and speaks, its session ledger and a mock; a barge-in cancels the response, drops its late audio and truncates at the heard sample.

items.detail: Since 0.5.0: the testkit target answers every scenario of the suite synthesized from the specification: 454 at 0.5.0, 460 at 0.6.0 and 0.7.0, and 462 on main.
items.label: Conformance suite

items.detail: Since 0.4.0: a pipeline is declared through commands or the typed builder, validated, and planned from its nodes' capabilities; a node bound to a model without a capability it requires is refused, naming both.
items.label: Pipelines checked before they run

items.detail: Since 0.5.0: a graph definition is validated against the runtime's node descriptors; a subgraph runs as one node of its parent and keeps its own cancellation and tracing boundary.
items.label: Declarative definitions and subgraphs

items.detail: Since 0.4.0: every edge has a capacity and one of seven overload policies; pause holds the producer until the consumer takes an event.
items.label: Bounded edges and overload policies

items.detail: Since 0.4.0: a run moves through its states under the controller, which prepares, starts, drains and stops node instances.
items.label: Run lifecycle and controller

items.detail: Since 0.5.0: a tool result goes back to the LLM node for the next turn of the same generation, up to an iteration bound; past it the proposal is rejected and the generation completes.
items.label: Bounded tool feedback loop

items.detail: Since 0.6.0: a recorder and a replay driver reproduce a run's control decisions, such as a barge-in and a tool call, in order.

items.detail: Since 0.6.0: planning refuses an adapter whose locality the deployment profile does not admit, inside subgraphs too, before anything opens.
